creative.heroVenue: Kedai Kana, Desa Sukur, North Minahasa
creative.tentangBody: Baciraro Creative is a platform for creative innovation that bridges Minahasa cultural heritage with plastic upcycling technology. We believe that tradition and sustainability can walk hand in hand — honoring ancestral wisdom while building a circular future through design, collaboration, and community empowerment.
creative.eventKonsepBody: A limited but representative dialogue forum exploring the evolution of Kawasaran attributes — tracing the red thread between cultural authenticity and recycled plastic innovation. Bringing together adat authorities, academics, artists, environmentalists, government, and youth.
eventPrinsip: Limited but representative — invitations based on capacity to contribute.
Dialogic, not ceremonial — prime time for speakers and invited participants.
Respecting adat authority — outcomes are called initial recommendations, not official adat decisions.
Non-judgmental toward innovation before hearing adat, historical, academic, artistic, environmental, government, and youth perspectives.
Clear documentation, recommendations, publication, and follow-up.

lokawaya.title: Lokawaya × Baciraro Creative
lokawaya.description: We participated in the Lokawaya event with a workshop turning bottle caps into keychains and a booth featuring Baciraro Creative products redeemable with Dobu or Doi Bulu.

detail.heroDesc: Baciraro Creative took part in the Lokawaya event — presenting a bottle cap upcycling workshop and a product booth redeemable with Dobu or Doi Bulu (1 Dobu = Rp 1).
detail.boothDesc: Our booth was filled with enthusiastic visitors exploring Baciraro Creative's recycled products. The unique payment system using Dobu or Doi Bulu made the experience even more engaging and interactive.
detail.workshopDesc: Visitors learned to transform plastic bottle caps into unique keychains. A child from the USA made their own keychain — proof that creativity and recycling can be enjoyed by all ages and backgrounds.
detail.visitorsDesc: Lokawaya attracted visitors from all walks of life — international tourists and locals alike, all enthusiastically engaging with Baciraro Creative's products and workshop.

dialogBudaya.title: Dialog Budaya Minahasa 2026
dialogBudaya.description: A limited dialogue forum tracing the evolution of Kawasaran attributes — bringing together adat authorities, academics, artists, environmentalists, government, and youth to untangle the red thread between cultural authenticity and recycled plastic innovation.

detail.heroDesc: The Dialog Budaya Minahasa 2026 forum was successfully held at Kedai Kana, Sukur Village, North Minahasa. The forum traced the evolution of Kawasaran attributes — untangling the red thread between cultural authenticity and recycled plastic innovation, bringing together adat authorities, academics, artists, environmentalists, government, and youth.

undangan.greetingBody: We are honored to invite you to the Dialog Budaya Minahasa 2026 — a dialogue forum exploring the evolution of Kawasaran attributes, bridging cultural authenticity and recycled plastic innovation.
undangan.detail1: A limited but representative dialogue forum featuring adat authorities, academics, artists, environmentalists, government representatives, and youth.
undangan.detail2: The forum will explore the philosophical meaning of traditional Kawasaran materials, the boundaries of sacred attributes, and the role of recycled plastic innovation in cultural preservation.
undangan.detail3: Outcomes will serve as initial recommendations — not official adat decisions — with clear documentation, publication, and follow-up.

ecosystemRegionData.title: Tomohon City
points: Organic Farming. Baciraro organic farming with farmers in Minahasa and Rurukan Tomohon develops organic agriculture through organic fertilizer supply. Organic fertilizer products are distributed to farmer groups with assistance from Baciraro through organic food production and marketing networks.

Organic Waste Management. Baciraro Recycle partners with producers (Nutrifood) to manage organic waste from pre-expired materials (3 months before expiry). Pre-expired materials are channeled to the waste bank network for members as feed material (milk protein), while expired materials are processed into organic fertilizer.

projectDetailData.title: "Setor Jo" Waste Bank
projectDetailData.description: A collaboration program between Baciraro Recycle and Pertamina Geothermal Energy in Minahasa Regency, particularly in the operational areas of Tompaso, West Tompaso, and North Langowan sub-districts. The program has established 4 waste banks with 15 more to follow. It supports Clean Minahasa by educating the community to sort waste and turn it into economic value.

projectDetailData.title: Education and Collecting
projectDetailData.description: A collaboration program between Baciraro Recycle and Danone in North Minahasa Regency, specifically in the Likupang Super Priority Destination area, to educate communities on waste management in tourism areas. The education program has reached over 1,000 people and reduced waste by 5 tons in 2022.

projectDetailData.title: Waste Bank Capacity Building
projectDetailData.description: A Waste Bank Capacity Building Program with the Ministry of Tourism and Creative Economy of the Republic of Indonesia. Capacity building for waste management in Likupang was conducted through Waste Bank Socialization and Waste Bank Management Training. 115 people were educated about waste and its solutions, resulting in 4 Waste Banks and 1 Recycling Center in East Likupang sub-district.

projectDetailData.title: Recycling Center Development
projectDetailData.description: A Recycling Center Development Program with the Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries of the Republic of Indonesia. Construction of plastic waste management facilities to produce furniture and craft products is underway. This program is expected to support the waste management ecosystem with circular economy principles in the Likupang Super Priority Tourism Destination.

projectDetailData.title: Baciraro Organic Farm
projectDetailData.description: An organic waste management program integrated with organic farming in Rurukan Village. The collaboration also involves the Eco-Enzyme Manado Community as a source of Eco-Enzyme pulp for mixing with organic fertilizer alongside organic waste from several corporate partners. Baciraro Organic Farm serves as an integrated organic waste management model supporting organic-based food security in North Sulawesi.

projectDetailData.title: 10% Movement
projectDetailData.description: A waste management education program through collaboration with English language education institutions in Sangihe. Participants only need to bring plastic bottles as payment to receive free courses. Baciraro Recycle allocates 10% of recycled product sales to support this program.

projectDetailData.title: Trash For Life
projectDetailData.description: A blood donation program through collaboration with a blood bank startup in Bitung together with PMI. The collaboration involves cafe and restaurant owners donating plastic waste — proceeds from transactions between the blood bank and Baciraro Recycle fund insurance for donors. The program has gained support from over 50 cafes and restaurants across Bitung City, Manado City, and North Minahasa.

productServiceData.title: Baciraro Eco-Craft
productServiceData.description: In support of circular economy in waste management in North Sulawesi, Baciraro Recycle partners with various parties including Souvenir Likupang to produce diverse products from recycled materials. The craft products produced by Baciraro Eco-Craft are expected to support the creative economy sector for the Likupang Super Priority Destination (DSP).

productServiceData.title: SROI Consulting
productServiceData.description: Performing SROI calculations for the Gellar Foundation's 23 SOE TJSL Collaboration Program in DSP Likupang. This consulting provides social impact insights for program implementation evaluation conducted in 2022. The program is part of the waste management ecosystem development plan in Likupang, particularly utilizing waste for craft products and supporting sustainable tourism with circular economy principles.

0.title: Reboisasi Gunung Klabat
0.narrative: The beginning of Baciraro's environmental awareness. Reforestation program in the Mount Klabat area with Aqua volunteers, planting trees to preserve forests and water resources in North Sulawesi.

1.title: Salvos Go Green
1.narrative: Salvos Go Green program, an environmental action by the Salvation Army Church involving tree planting and environmental education in North Sulawesi. Tree planting action by Salvation Army Youth throughout Indonesia focused on reforestation and environmental awareness.

2.title: Community-Based Waste Management on Bunaken Island
2.narrative: Assistance for the BRITS waste management group on Bunaken Island. Collaboration with the North Sulawesi Provincial Environmental Agency. Implementation of a community-based Waste Bank system. Awarded the 2012 MDGs award for community initiative-based waste management.

3.title: Klabat Lestari Program with Aqua
3.narrative: Conservation program for Mount Klabat in partnership with Aqua. Involving community groups in environmental conservation, reforestation, and waste management activities in the Mount Klabat area.

4.title: Biogas Study & Kencana Online Technology
4.narrative: A visit by the Minahasa cooperative team to PT Kencana Online in Bandung to study biogas technology, composters, and renewable energy. Learning about biodigester systems, biogas generators, biogas stoves, and biogas purification for sustainable energy management.

5.title: Tondano Landfill Observation
5.narrative: Observation of conditions at the Final Processing Site (TPA) in Tondano to understand waste management systems and their impact on the surrounding environment.

6.title: Manado River Pollution Documentation
6.narrative: Documentation of river conditions in Manado polluted by waste. This data and documentation served as the foundation for advocacy and education on waste management in Manado City.

7.title: Climate Reality Project Indonesia
7.narrative: Participation in the Climate Reality Project Indonesia in Jakarta. A climate change training and advocacy program initiated by former US Vice President Al Gore.

8.title: Klabat Lestari Program - Hutan Kenangan
8.narrative: Tree planting activities at Hutan Kenangan as part of the Klabat Lestari Program. Involving composting and tree planting in the foothills of Mount Klabat.

9.title: Water Hyacinth Research on Lake Tondano
9.narrative: Research on water hyacinth in Lake Tondano in collaboration with Groningen University Netherlands and Bank Indonesia. Also conducted visits to organic farming sites in Rurukan and meetings with Lantos Pin from Groningen University.

10.title: Indonesia Carbon Update
10.narrative: Indonesia Carbon Update seminar with Rahmat Witular (former Minister of Environment) and Steven Sumolang (anthropology researcher, Chair of the Sulut Mountenering Forum).

11.title: Klabat Lestari Socialization
11.narrative: Socialization of the Klabat Lestari Program by the Green Community Forum of North Sulawesi to expand the impact of Mount Klabat conservation.

12.title: Indonesian Tour Guide Association Outbound
12.narrative: Outbound activity for the management of the Indonesian Tour Guide Association (HPI) as part of organizational capacity building.

13.title: Lake Limboto Documentation
13.narrative: Documentation of Lake Limboto's siltation due to water hyacinth, serving as a foundation for waste and pollution management advocacy in North Sulawesi.

14.title: Establishment of Polri TV North Sulawesi
14.narrative: Meeting for the establishment of Polri TV in North Sulawesi. Baciraro's involvement in communication forums and police media development in the North Sulawesi region.

15.title: Taponesia Tree Planting Application
15.narrative: Development of the Taponesia tree planting application featuring a dashboard, social wall, and profile menu. A digital innovation for monitoring reforestation and greening activities.

16.title: Green Community Forum Tree Planting
16.narrative: Tree planting action by the Green Community Forum of North Minahasa. Involving tree identification and planting at various locations across North Minahasa.

17.title: SMASH Waste Bank Application
17.narrative: Development of the SMASH online waste bank application. Facilitating the implementation of a digital waste bank system in Manado City for integration with cashless systems.

18.title: Agape Waste Bank Launch
18.narrative: Launch of the Agape Waste Bank in Tumaluntung Village, Kauditan District. Establishment of a community-based waste bank for village-level waste management.

19.title: Danone Jakarta Meeting
19.narrative: Meeting with Danone Headquarters in Jakarta to explore collaboration on waste management and the Wise Plastic program in North Sulawesi.

20.title: Pinili Village Agricultural Program
20.narrative: Seedling and agricultural program in Pinili Village. Including chili seedling cultivation, seeding, and rice planting as part of sustainable agricultural development.

21.title: Simfoni Waste Bank
21.narrative: Launch of the Simfoni Waste Bank at the Easter Festival and development of congregation-based waste banks to support tourism in North Sulawesi. This waste bank serves as a community-based waste collection and sorting center.

22.title: Adiwiyata Program at SMA Negeri 7 Manado
22.narrative: Mentoring SMA Negeri 7 Manado towards becoming an Independent Adiwiyata School. Included waste bank launch, composter production, composting, and waste management education within the school environment. Successfully achieved the Independent Adiwiyata School award.

23.title: Sumompo Landfill Visit
23.narrative: Visit to the Sumompo Final Processing Site (TPA) to study the waste management system and discuss recycling development potential with the CELS Cooperative.

24.title: Waste Management at Siladen Resort
24.narrative: Waste processing training for employees at Siladen Resort and a workshop on waste management and circular economy. An initiative to repurpose used wine bottles into glasses and value-added products in the tourism area.

25.title: Celebes Energi Lestari Cooperative (CELS)
25.narrative: Development of the CELS Cooperative as the first waste bank cooperative in North Sulawesi. Exploring hospital waste management partnerships with Siloam Hospital and visiting Pertamina Geothermal for waste management synergy.

26.title: Adipura Bitung Waste Bank
26.narrative: Establishment of the Adipura waste bank in Bitung City to support urban cleanliness and greening programs. Included socialization, establishment, and waste bank operations.

27.title: Bangka Island Waste Sorting
27.narrative: Waste sorting activities from the sea around Bangka Island in collaboration with the Bangka Conservation Foundation. Efforts to reduce plastic waste pollution in marine conservation areas.

28.title: Recycling Technology Development
28.narrative: Development of equipment to distill plastic waste into fuel oil and manufacture bricks from plastic waste residue. Collaboration with Politeknik Negeri Manado for the production of waste shredding machines.

29.title: Ecobrick Sofa Production
29.narrative: Innovation in manufacturing sofas from ecobricks (used plastic bottles). Environmentally friendly furniture products that became Baciraro's icon in the circular economy and plastic waste recycling.

30.title: Griffith University Australia Visit
30.narrative: Visit by Prof. Noel Scott from Griffith University Australia to the Simfoni Waste Bank and Politeknik Negeri Manado. A study on sustainable tourism and sustainable waste management in tourism areas.

31.title: Paintings and Art from Plastic Waste
31.narrative: Processing plastic waste and used towels into paintings and creative products. Recycling innovation that transforms waste into high-value art pieces.

32.title: APSI National Conference
32.narrative: Participation in the National Conference of the Indonesian Waste Entrepreneurs Association (APSI) and becoming part of the management of Indonesia's plastic recycling entrepreneurs organization.

33.title: Simfoni Waste Bank Operations
33.narrative: Daily operations of the Simfoni Waste Bank including plastic bottle sorting, weighing, customer passbook issuance, and waste management. This waste bank serves as a community-based circular economy center.

34.title: Crafts from Used Towels
34.narrative: Innovation in recycling used towels into pots, earrings, and various craft products. A community empowerment program through textile recycling creativity.

35.title: Media Coverage and Public Discussion
35.narrative: Served as a resource person on Kompas TV Sapa Manado with the theme 'Manado and Waste', as well as a discussion on flooding on TVRI. Media coverage and public education on waste management.

36.title: AIS Exhibition and Marine Events
36.narrative: Participation in the AIS (Archipelagic and Island States) exhibition with marine researchers from around the world. Introducing waste management innovations and waste banks to the international community.

37.title: Waste Bank Socialization with PGE
37.narrative: Socialization of the waste bank program with Pertamina Geothermal Energy in PADIOR. Education on waste sorting and waste bank establishment in PGE's operational areas.

38.title: 1000 Digital Startup Competition
38.narrative: Baciraro Recycle introduced itself as a digital startup innovating in source waste management, including digital-based waste banks and circular economy ecosystems. A national program of the Indonesian Ministry of Communication and Informatics.

39.title: Plastic Brick Project from Waste
39.narrative: Plastic Brick, a collaborative project with Trash Waste Solution to manufacture plastic bricks from waste, addressing the issue of reducing plastic waste pollution in the ocean. Connected activities between the Trash Waste Solution team on Siladen Island and Baciraro Recycle. Produced using standard Precious Plastic machinery.

40.title: Setor Jo Waste Bank & Eco-Enzyme Program
40.narrative: Collaboration program with Pertamina Geothermal Energy Lahendong covering plastic waste sorting education and eco-enzyme training. The Setor Jo Waste Bank Program in North Pinabetengan Village and the development of recycled products.

41.title: Danone Aqua Wise Plastic Program
41.narrative: Partnership between Danone Aqua and Baciraro Recycle for plastic waste collection facilities, supported by the Likupang Nature Lovers Community. Strengthening the DPSP Likupang waste management ecosystem.

42.title: Coastal Village Program & BUMN Collaboration
42.narrative: Collaboration with the Ministry of Maritime Affairs, Fisheries, and the Ministry of Tourism for fisherfolk empowerment and tourism villages. The Clean Coastal Village Program in Serawet Village and Waste Bank Management training.

43.title: Dialog Budaya Minahasa 2026
43.narrative: A dialogue forum exploring the evolution of the Kawasaran attributes — unravelling the common thread between cultural authenticity and recycled plastic innovation. Bringing together traditional leaders, academics, artists, environmental activists, government, and the younger generation at Kedai Kana, Sukur Village, North Minahasa.

44.title: Lokawaya × Baciraro Creative
44.narrative: Baciraro Creative's participation in the Lokawaya event — a workshop turning bottle caps into keychains and a product booth exchangeable for Dobu or Doi Bulu. Visited by enthusiastic local and foreign tourists interacting with recycled products.
